notes.title: Upcoming CYBRLICH Events
notes.content:
Greetings corporate slackers and skeleton slayers. We hope this email finds you well. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341349/e9c3c781fc66ae07bf1a90368457a7292ccee2f2.gif"]
Have you been itching for a chance to play CYBRLICH and the Death Cult of Labor? We'll be on the ground at two events in New York City soon! 




[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341349/2a19697d2be09e75b0f0e9e00f22289f11dee03c.jpg"]
Thursday, July 24th, from 6pm - 10pm you can catch us at BrookLAN's NYC Indie Dev Night.
NYC INDIE DEV NIGHT

 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341349/fac99a1732be761ea7c633cd0a0416404117ed35.jpg"]
August 22 - 24, we'll be at Anime NYC as part of the PLAY.nyc experience.
ANIME.NYC

 


Want to stay up to date on all things CYBRLICH? Join our discord! Discord members see all of our new content first, and it's also a chill place to hang. Who doesn't want more friends?
CYBRLICH DISCORD

 
Finally, we encourage all CYBRLICH fans to pre-save our Kickstarter campaign. This isn't a pledge for money, it just lets you get notified when our campaign goes live. These pre-saves help us out tremendously, so please sign up! You'll receive our undying gratitude.
KICKSTARTER PRE-SAVE



Hope to see you at BrookLAN and PLAY.nyc!

Kind Regards,
CYBRLICH Studios

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341349/4bccbfdf0a7f011e07fac69b4e39445adc3c17c7.gif"]
